note: Rewritten from the species-level Description (Imago/Soldier/Pseudoworkers) in Treubia 30(3), the original in English; the material is 2 alates, 1 soldier and 5 pseudoworkers (Panaitan Island, Indonesia, collected by Takuya Abe, 1982). The original calls the worker caste pseudoworker (Kalotermitidae have no true workers). OCR problems: the text reads Total NOSARE ca. 6.60 mm for Total length; the dealate body length is 5.40—5.75 mm in the text and 5.60—5.75 mm in Table 9, and both are kept; items 9, 10, 11 and 12 of Table 9 (least ocellus diameter etc.) are truncated by OCR and are not included.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head capsule and antennae pale yellow to light brown; wings and main veins light brown to rusty brown, darker than the head capsule; postclypeus slightly darker than the head capsule; the rest of the body cream yellow. Head capsule sparsely hairy, thoracic nota with a row of hairs along the margins, abdomen with hairs of moderate density. Body length including the wings 6.50—6.60 mm; body length without the wings 5.40—5.75 mm (5.60—5.75 mm in the measurement table).
Head: head capsule subrectangular, distinctly longer than wide; lateral margins nearly straight at the compound eyes; posterior margin rounded. Y-shaped suture present, its median arm faintly visible. Fontanelle absent. Compound eyes small, greatest diameter including the eye facets 0.18—0.20 mm, least diameter 0.15—0.19 mm; about 0.10 mm from the lower margin of the head and about 0.03 mm from the antennal socket. Ocelli 2, small, oval, translucent, on the sides of the head, almost touching the compound eye, only about 0.02 mm apart. Antennae 11—12-segmented; segment 1 longest, cylindrical; in the 11-segmented antenna segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3; segment 3 longer than segment 5; segment 4 shortest; the rest clavate, segments 5—8 nearly equal in length, gradually longer from segment 9; terminal segment oval. Clypeus subtrapezoidal, anterior margin weakly convex, the boundary between the anteclypeus and postclypeus indistinct. Labrum slightly narrowed forwards, anterior margin weakly convex, with several long hairs near the anterior margin and on the clypeal body. Mandibles of the typical tree-termite type.
Thorax: pronotum subreniform, much wider than long; anterior margin broadly concave; lateral margins weakly convex, slightly receding posteriorly; posterior lateral corners rounded and acute; posterior margin nearly straight, with an indistinct concavity in the middle. Wings translucent, the membrane distinctly granular; fore wing scale slightly longer than the hind wing scale; all veins arise independently from the wing scale; costa, subcosta, radius, radial sector and media strongly sclerotized and thick; cubitus generally weak, slightly distinct near the wing scale; costa running along the anterior margin of the wing to the tip; subcosta slender, merging with the costa a short distance beyond the wing scale; radius short, arising independently, joining the costa at about 1/6 of the wing membrane; radial sector and media arising independently from the wing scale, curving upwards and running parallel to the anterior margin; cubitus with 15—18 branches. Hind wing with costa, radius and radial sector as in the fore wing; media arising from the radial sector at about 1/4 of the wing membrane, close to and parallel with the radial sector to the tip; cubitus as in the fore wing, with 13—15 branches. Legs short, hairy; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented; arolium present. Measurements (mm): head length to the tip of the clypeus 1.00—1.03; head length to the mandible base 0.80—0.85; greatest head width including the compound eyes 0.75—0.80; greatest ocellus diameter 0.07—0.08; pronotum length 0.43—0.45, width 0.70—0.75.
Abdomen: elongate oval, hairy. Cerci 2-segmented, about 0.07—0.10 mm long; styli single-segmented, about 0.05—0.07 mm long.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head capsule yellowish brown, paler posteriorly; antennae brownish yellow; mandibles dark brown, reddish brown at the base; frons and postclypeus darker; the sides of the pronotum translucent, yellow with a brownish tinge; the rest of the body much paler than the head capsule. Head capsule and pronotum sparsely hairy; abdomen and legs with hairs of moderate density; the 10th abdominal tergite more strongly sclerotized. Body length about 6.60 mm.
Head: head capsule much longer than wide, widest at about the posterior 1/3, the sides nearly parallel almost to the antennal bases and from there slightly narrowing forwards; posterior lateral margins rounded; posterior margin weakly convex; frons gently sloping forwards; anterior dorsal corners with a lateral groove; Y-shaped suture faint, its median arm more distinct, reaching the occiput. Fontanelle absent. Compound eyes 2, lateral, oval, unpigmented, flush with the head surface, about 0.13 mm from the antennal socket. Ocelli small, dot-like. Antennae 9-segmented; segment 1 largest; segment 2 cylindrical, about as long as segments 3 and 4 together; segment 3 shortest; segment 5 to the penultimate segment pyriform, gradually longer; terminal segment oval. Clypeus: anteclypeus a thin, pale, translucent, hairless transverse band; postclypeus indistinctly separated from the frons. Labrum broadly lingulate, only slightly wider than long; sides nearly parallel; anterior margin nearly straight; hairs on the tip and on the clypeal body. Mandibles short, tapering towards the tip, the tip strongly incurved, less than half the head length; outer margin weakly concave at the base. Left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the cutting edge between the 1st and 2nd marginal teeth in the middle 2/3. Postmentum long, clavate, only slightly shorter than the head length without the mandibles; greatest width at the apical 1/3; the waist long; anterior margin nearly straight; posterior margin broadly concave, projecting in the middle.
Thorax: pronotum subrectangular, almost as wide as the head capsule, much wider than long (pronotal index 0.52); anterior margin deeply concave with a distinct median notch; anterior lateral corners angular; lateral margins nearly straight, slightly receding posteriorly; posterior lateral corners rounded; posterior margin distinctly concave in the middle. Mesonotum nearly square, slightly wider than the pronotum; anterior margin straight; lateral margins slightly expanding posteriorly; posterior lateral corners angular; posterior margin nearly straight. Metanotum slightly wider than the mesonotum; posterior margin nearly straight, weakly concave in the middle.
Abdomen: elongate, with hairs of moderate density. Cerci 2-segmented, small, about 0.07 mm long; styli single-segmented, about 0.05 mm long. Measurements (mm, holotype soldier): head length including the mandibles 1.82; head length to the mandible base 1.35; greatest head width 0.93; width at the lateral mandible base 0.75; width at the lateral antennal base 0.88; head index I (width/length) 0.69; head index II (mandible base width/greatest width) 0.81; head index III (antennal base width/greatest head width) 0.95; left and right mandible length 0.58 each; head-mandible index I 0.43; postmentum median length 0.88; postmentum greatest width 0.35, least width 0.23; pronotum length 0.48, width 0.93; pronotal index 0.52.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text:
Pseudoworker large: head capsule cream yellow; postclypeus brownish, darker than the frons; labrum pale brown, translucent; antennae creamy white with yellow; the rest of the body creamy white, paler than the head capsule; pronotum weakly sclerotized. Head and body sparsely hairy, the pronotum with somewhat more hairs. Body length 5.20—6.00 mm.
Head: head capsule nearly circular, slightly wider than long (to the mandible base); widest in the lower half near the middle; lateral margins convex, weakly converging forwards and more distinctly posteriorly; posterior margin convex. Fontanelle absent. Antennae 10—11-segmented; segment 1 largest; segment 2 cylindrical, narrower than segment 1, about 1½ times segment 3; segment 3 shortest; in the 11-segmented antenna segment 2 about as long as segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 narrowest and shortest, segments 4 to the penultimate gradually larger and broadly pyriform, the terminal segment oval and narrower than the penultimate. Specimen 1 has a 9-segmented right antenna, segments 2 and 3 narrowest, segment 2 about twice segment 3, segment 3 shortest. Clypeus, labrum and mandibles as in the alate.
Thorax: pronotum subreniform, distinctly wider than long, almost as wide as the head or slightly narrower; anterior margin truncate, broadly concave in the middle, without a notch; lateral margins weakly convex, receding posteriorly; posterior margin weakly convex, slightly concave in the middle. Mesonotum slightly wider than the pronotum; lateral margins nearly straight, expanding posteriorly to angular posterior lateral corners; posterior margin raised in the middle. Metanotum slightly wider than the mesonotum, posterior margin as in the mesonotum.
Abdomen: cylindrical. Cerci 0.08—0.10 mm long; styli 0.10 mm long. The small pseudoworker resembles the large pseudoworker except for its smaller size: body length 3.90 mm; head length to the tip of the clypeus 0.90, head length to the mandible base 0.70, greatest head width 0.73, head height 0.43; pronotum length 0.38, width 0.65 mm.
